questions.question:
Eight persons Reena, Kiran, Rahul, Deepak, Amit, Vikas, Preeti and Priya sit around a square table such that two persons sit in each of the sides. All the persons are sitting facing the centre of the table.

Reena sits on the immediate right of Amit and they both sit on the same side. Preeti faces the one who is second to the left of Kiran. Preeti is sitting fourth to the right of Reena. Two persons sit between Vikas and Deepak (when counted from one side only) and Deepak is adjacent to Amit. Only one person sits between Preeti and Rahul (when counted from one side only). Who is sitting to the immediate left of Deepak?
questions.solution:
According to the given information,

1) Reena sits on the immediate right of Amit and they both sit on the same side.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d9e59576bd265eeae4f588cd7904a91caf0ee7d13f74777a404d5417b5a6a138.png] 

2) Preeti is sitting fourth to the right of Reena.

3) Preeti faces the one who is second to the left of Kiran. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac26f3695dc37d5bc62a173e340354a8ed52997741d4a5e471736be241b4c604.png] 

4) Two persons sit between Vikas and Deepak (when counted from one side only) and Deepak is adjacent to Amit. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3870c39029d93e0a94cea82cf6c0efd6b66f53e543e189bee9aea6875d7a609d.png] 

5) Only one person sits between Preeti and Rahul (when counted from one side only).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc7adb067003e530f5e920462d487e298a0e794309043a4da56b5372cb96cfdc.png] 

Here, we can see that Priya is sitting to the immediate left of Deepak.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.

questions.question: Six persons P1, P2, P3, P4, P5 and P6 are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Only two persons are sitting between P2 and P6 from the either sides. Only one person is sitting between P2 and P4. P5 is sitting to the immediate right of P3. P1 is sitting second to the right of P6. Who is sitting on the immediate right of P1?
questions.solution:
According to the given information,

1) Only two persons are sitting between P2 and P6 from the either sides.

Here, we can see that P2 is sitting on the immediate right of P1.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.

questions.question: In a certain code language, 'PAGES' is coded as '192', 'ABOVE' is coded as '180'. What is the code for 'PRIOR' in that code language?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: (Sum of the place value of the alphabets) × 4 = Code

'PAGES' is coded as '192',

⇒ (16 + 1 + 7 + 5 + 19) × 4

⇒ 48 × 4 = 192.

'ABOVE' is coded as '180'

⇒ (1 + 2 + 15 + 22 + 5) × 4

⇒ 45 × 4 = 180.

Similarly, for '**PRIOR**'

⇒ **(16 + 18 + 9 + 15 + 18)** **× 4**

**⇒ 76 × 4 = 304.**

So, 'PRIOR' will be written as '**304**'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
